```{r load}
  readxl::read_xlsx(
    paste0(#path,

  rename(date_of_infection_1 = date_of_infection_109,
         infection_severity_1 = infection_severity_severe_hospitalization_or_requiring_iv_antibiotics_108,
         date_of_infection_2 = date_of_infection_112,
         infection_severity_2 = infection_severity_severe_hospitalization_or_requiring_iv_antibiotics_111,
         date_of_infection_3 = date_of_infection_115,
         infection_severity_3 = infection_severity_severe_hospitalization_or_requiring_iv_antibiotics_114,

         infection_severity_4 = infection_severity_severe_hospitalization_or_requiring_iv_antibiotics_117,

  `colnames<-`(str_remove_all(colnames(.), "_bacterial_viral_fungal"))

  readxl::read_xlsx(
    paste0(#path, 
      here::here(), "/data/2026_analysis",
      "/Stage_Weightloss_PHI.xlsx"), 
    sheet = "Stage_Weight",
    na = c("NA")
  ) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(mrn, patient_identifier, contains("weight"), 
         ldh_elevated_at_index, contains("iss"), 
         -weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg)
```

```{r}
data_check <- 
  data |> select(mrn, patient_identifier,
                 bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4, 
                 date_of_last_exposure_to_prior_bcma_agent, prior_gprc5d_yes_no, prior_cart_0_no_1_yes, 
                 most_recent_bcma_agent_name, if_prior_cart_which_one_s, 
                 if_prior_adc_which_one_s, if_so_what_combinational_agent_s_given_with_bs_ab,
                 date_of_last_gprc5d_exposure, date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date,
                 date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1) |> 
  mutate(mrn = as.character(mrn)) |> 
  arrange(mrn, date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1) |> 
  group_by(mrn) |> 
  mutate(duplicated_ids = case_when(
    n() == 2           ~ "Yes",
    TRUE               ~ "No"
  )) |> 
  mutate(which_first = row_number()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4 = case_when(
    bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4 == 1          ~ "Teclistamab",
    bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4 == 2          ~ "Talquetamab",
    bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4 == 3          ~ "Elra",
    bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4 == 4          ~ "Linvo",
    TRUE                                                ~ NA_character_
  )) |> 
  mutate(time_last_gprc5d_to_initiation_days = 
           interval(
             start = date_of_last_gprc5d_exposure,
             end = date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1)/
           duration(n=1, units = "days"),
         .after = date_of_last_gprc5d_exposure) %>%
  mutate(time_most_recent_bcma_to_initiation_days = 
           interval(
             start = date_of_last_exposure_to_prior_bcma_agent,
             end = date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1)/
           duration(n=1, units = "days"),
         .after = date_of_last_exposure_to_prior_bcma_agent) %>%
  mutate(date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date = case_when(
    date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date == 0       ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE                 ~ date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date
  )) |> 
  mutate(date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date = 
           as.Date(as.numeric(date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date), 
                          # tryFormats = c("%m/%d/%y", "%m/%d/%Y"), 
                          origin = "1899-12-30"))

data_check |> 
  filter(duplicated_ids == "Yes") |> #select(mrn) |> unique() |> as.vector()
  select(mrn, bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4, which_first) |> 
  tbl_summary(by = bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4,
              statistic = list(c(all_continuous()) ~ c(
                "{median} ({min}, {max})")))

a <- data_check |> 
  filter(time_most_recent_bcma_to_initiation_days < 0 |
           time_last_gprc5d_to_initiation_days < 0) |> 
  select(bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4, 
         mrn, patient_identifier,
         time_most_recent_bcma_to_initiation_days,
         date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1,
         date_of_last_exposure_to_prior_bcma_agent, 
         date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date,
         
         
         time_last_gprc5d_to_initiation_days,
         date_of_last_gprc5d_exposure,
         prior_gprc5d_yes_no, prior_cart_0_no_1_yes, 
         most_recent_bcma_agent_name, if_prior_cart_which_one_s, 
         if_prior_adc_which_one_s, if_so_what_combinational_agent_s_given_with_bs_ab,
  )
  
  
```




```{r fix name date and recode 012etc}
data1 <- data %>% 
  full_join(., stage, by = c("mrn", "patient_identifier")) |> 
  # General----
  mutate(mrn = as.character(mrn)) |> 
  # Fix letter case and missing
  # mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace(., "NE|ND|N/A|Not done", NA_character_))) %>%
  mutate(across(c(where(is.character),
                  -c("patient_identifier",
                     "myeloma_involved_heavy_chain_ig_g_ig_a_ig_m_ig_d_ig_e_or_blank",
                     "specific_debulking_therapy_used_prior_to_bs_ab",
                     "best_response_to_treatment_number_1_after_post_bi_te_progression",
                     "best_response_to_treatment_number_2_after_post_bi_te_progression",
                     "pathogen"
                     )),
                ~ str_to_sentence(.) )) %>%
  mutate(across(c(contains("vgpr") #"response_to_bridging_chemotherapy"
                  ),
                ~ str_to_upper(.) )) %>%
  # Recode Y/N
  mutate_at(c("tal_specifically_designed_as_pre_car_t_holding_or_bridging_y_n"
  ), 
  ~ case_when(
    . == "Y"                                              ~ "Yes",
    . == "N"                                              ~ "No",
    TRUE                                                ~ as.character(.)
  )) %>% 
  # Recode 0/1
  mutate_at(c("prophylactic_tocilizumab_n_0_y_1",
              "cerebellar_toxicity_or_ataxia_if_so_describe",
              "infection_n_0_y_1", 
              "infection_severity_1", "infection_severity_2",
              "infection_severity_3", "infection_severity_4",
              "recurrent_crs_n_0_y_1",
              "tocilizumab_as_tx_n_0_y_1", "steroid_use_as_tx_n_0_y_1", "anakinra_n_0_y_1",
              "bs_ab_combined_at_any_point_such_as_with_pom_dara_or_other_bs_ab_no_0_yes_1",
              "bs_ab_served_only_as_pre_car_t_bridging_0_no_1_yes",
              "oligo_or_non_secretory_at_bs_ab_initiation_0_no_1_yes",
              "deletion_17p_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes", "t_4_14_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes", 
              "t_11_14_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes", "t_14_16_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes", 
              "gain_amp1q21_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes", "amp_1_q_only_0_no_1_yes",
              "deletion_1p_0_no_1_yes",
              "prior_auto_sct_no_0_yes_1",
              "prior_bcma_directed_therapy_no_0_y_1",
              "prior_cart_0_no_1_yes",
              "triple_class_refractory_i_mi_d_pi_anti_cd38_no_0_y_1",
              "penta_refractory_2_p_is_2_i_mi_ds_anti_cd38_no_0_y_1",
              "debulking_therapy_prior_to_bs_ab_no_0_y_1",
              "did_patient_receive_xrt_in_combination_with_bs_ab_no_0_yes_1",
              "h_o_plasma_cell_leukemia_no_0_yes_1",
              "eligible_for_corresponding_bs_ab_trial_on_first_dose_use_trial_elig_sheet_to_help_you_no_0_y_1",
              "step_up_initiated_inpatient_or_outpatient",
              "hemodialysis_pre_bs_ab_y_1_n_0",
              "icu_admission_during_first_cycle_n_0_y_1",
              "need_for_gcsf", "need_for_tpo_agonist",
              "ivig_n_0_y_1"
  ), 
  ~ case_when(
    . == 0                                              ~ "No",
    . == 1                                              ~ "Yes",
    TRUE                                                ~ as.character(.)
  )) %>% 
  mutate(prior_auto_sct_no_0_yes_1 = case_when(
    prior_auto_sct_no_0_yes_1 == "9"                    ~ "No",
    TRUE                                                ~ prior_auto_sct_no_0_yes_1
  )) |> 
  mutate(high_marrow_burden_50_percent_p_cs_if_checked_within_30_days_before_bs_ab_initiation = 
           as.numeric(high_marrow_burden_50_percent_p_cs_if_checked_within_30_days_before_bs_ab_initiation)) |> 
  mutate(high_marrow_burden_50_percent_p_cs_if_checked_within_30_days_before_bs_ab_initiation = case_when(
    high_marrow_burden_50_percent_p_cs_if_checked_within_30_days_before_bs_ab_initiation < 0.5        ~ "No",
    high_marrow_burden_50_percent_p_cs_if_checked_within_30_days_before_bs_ab_initiation > 0.5       ~ "Yes",
    TRUE       ~ as.character(high_marrow_burden_50_percent_p_cs_if_checked_within_30_days_before_bs_ab_initiation)
  )) |> 
  mutate(bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4 = case_when(
    bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4 == 1          ~ "Teclistamab",
    bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4 == 2          ~ "Talquetamab",
    bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4 == 3          ~ "Elra",
    bs_ab_name_tec_1_tal_2_elra_3_linvo_4 == 4          ~ "Linvo",
    TRUE                                                ~ NA_character_
  )) %>% 
  mutate(bs_ab_sud_inpatient_0_bs_ab_sup_outpatient_1 = case_when(
    bs_ab_sud_inpatient_0_bs_ab_sup_outpatient_1 == 0   ~ "Inpatient",
    bs_ab_sud_inpatient_0_bs_ab_sup_outpatient_1 == 1   ~ "Outpatient"
  )) |> 



  mutate(reason_no_date_of_first_bs_ab_full_dose = case_when(
    str_detect(date_of_first_bs_ab_full_dose, "([A-Za-z]+)")     ~ date_of_first_bs_ab_full_dose
  ), .after = date_of_first_bs_ab_full_dose) |> 
  # mutate(was_discontinued = case_when(
  #   date_of_disocntinuation_if_cotinues_enter_0 == 0     ~ "Continued",
  #   !is.na(date_of_disocntinuation_if_cotinues_enter_0)  ~ "Discontinued"
  # ), .after = ) %>%
  # Dates
  mutate(date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date = case_when(
    date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date == 0       ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE                 ~ date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date
  )) |> 
  mutate(across(c(#"date_of_mm_diagnosis",
                  # "date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1",
                  "date_of_first_bs_ab_full_dose",
                  # "date_of_max_ferritin",
                  # "date_of_max_crp",
                  # "date_of_onset_of_crs",
                  "date_of_max_crs",
                  # "date_of_onset_of_icans",
                  # "date_of_max_ican",
                  # "date_of_infection_1st",
                  # "date_of_infection_2nd",
                  # "date_of_infection_3rd",
                  # "date_of_infection_4th",
                  # "anc_nadir_date", "hgb_nadir_date",
                  # "plt_nadir_date", "date_of_ig_g_nadir",
                  # "date_of_first_ivig_dose_following_bs_ab_administration",
                  # "date_of_best_mrd_response_relative_to_bs_ab_start",
                  # "date_of_pd",
                  "date_of_discontinuation_if_continues_enter_0_bs_ab_stop_date"
                  # "date_of_death", "date_of_last_contact",
                  # "date_of_first_exposure_to_prior_bcma_agent",
                  # "date_of_last_exposure_to_prior_bcma_agent",
                  # "date_last_exposure",
                  # "while_on_bs_ab_date_of_first_documented_emd_response",
                  # "date_of_best_documented_emd_response",
                  # "date_of_last_imaging_before_data_cutoff_only_in_pts_who_are_still_responding"
                  ),
                ~ as.Date(as.numeric(.), 
                          # tryFormats = c("%m/%d/%y", "%m/%d/%Y"), 
                          origin = "1899-12-30")))
```

```{r}
data2 <- data1 %>% 
  # Age categories----
  mutate(age_cat = case_when(
    age_at_bs_ab_initiation < 70                                         ~ "< 70 years",
    age_at_bs_ab_initiation >= 70                                        ~ "≥ 70 years"
  ),
  age_cat = factor(age_cat, levels = c("< 70 years", "≥ 70 years")),
  .after = age_at_bs_ab_initiation
  ) %>%
  mutate(age_3cat = case_when(
    age_at_bs_ab_initiation < 65                                         ~ "< 65",
    age_at_bs_ab_initiation >= 65 &
      age_at_bs_ab_initiation < 75                                       ~ "65 to < 70",
    age_at_bs_ab_initiation >= 75                                        ~ "75 and above"
  ),
  age_3cat = factor(age_3cat, levels = c("< 65", "65 to < 70", "75 and above")),
  .after = age_cat
  ) %>%
  mutate(year_bsab = year(date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1)) %>%
  # Sex categories----
  mutate(sex_0_male_1_female = case_when(
    sex_0_male_1_female == 0                  ~ "Male",
    sex_0_male_1_female == 1                  ~ "Female",
    TRUE                                      ~ as.character(sex_0_male_1_female)
  )) %>%
  mutate(male_sex = case_when(
    sex_0_male_1_female == "Male"                                    ~ 1,
    sex_0_male_1_female == "Female"                                  ~ 0
  ), .after = sex_0_male_1_female) %>%
  # Race eth
  rename_at(vars(contains("race")), ~ "race") %>%
  rename_at(vars(contains("hispanic")), ~ "ethnicity") %>%
  mutate(race = case_when(
    race == 0                                 ~ "White",
    race == 1                                 ~ "Black",
    race == 2                                 ~ "Asian American and Pacific Islander",
    race == 3                                 ~ "American indian",
    race == 4                                 ~ "Other",
    race == 5                                 ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                      ~ as.character(race)
  )) %>%
  mutate(ethnicity = case_when(
    ethnicity == 0                            ~ "Non-Hispanic",
    ethnicity == 1                            ~ "Hispanic",
    TRUE                                      ~ as.character(ethnicity)
  )) %>%
  mutate(raceeth = case_when(
    ethnicity == "Hispanic"                   ~ "Hispanic, any races",
    race == "White" &
      ethnicity == "Non-Hispanic"             ~ "White, Non-Hispanic",
    race == "Black" &
      ethnicity == "Non-Hispanic"             ~ "Black, Non-Hispanic",
    !is.na(race) &
      ethnicity == "Non-Hispanic"             ~ "Other, Non-Hispanic",
    TRUE                                      ~ NA_character_ # paste(race, ethnicity)
  ), raceeth = factor(raceeth, levels = c("White, Non-Hispanic",
                                          "Black, Non-Hispanic",
                                          "Hispanic, any races"))
  ) %>%
  # ECOG
  mutate_at(c("ecog_ps_at_bs_ab_initiation_0_5"), 
            ~ factor(.)
  ) %>%
  mutate(ecog_ps_at_bs_ab_initiation_0_5_cat = case_when(
    ecog_ps_at_bs_ab_initiation_0_5 == 0 |
      ecog_ps_at_bs_ab_initiation_0_5 == 1                                ~ "0-1",
    ecog_ps_at_bs_ab_initiation_0_5 %in% c(2:5)                           ~ "2-5"
  )) %>%
  mutate(weight_cat = case_when(
    weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg <= 70                                ~ "≤70",
    weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg > 70 &
      weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg <= 80                              ~ ">70 to 80",
    weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg > 80 &
      weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg <= 100                             ~ ">80 to 100",
    weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg > 100 &
      weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg <= 109                             ~ ">100 to 109",
    weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg > 109                                ~ ">109"
  ),
  weight_cat = factor(weight_cat, levels = c("≤70", ">70 to 80",
                                             ">80 to 100", ">100 to 109",
                                             ">109")),
  .after = weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg
  ) %>%
  mutate(cohort_n = nrow(.)) |> 
  # weight loss 30days
  mutate(weight_change_30days_num = weight_30_days_kg - weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg) |>
  mutate(percentage_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days = ((weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg - weight_30_days_kg) / 
                                                          weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg) * 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(percentage1_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days = sum(percentage_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(cohort_percentage1_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days = (percentage1_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days /
                                                                  cohort_n) * 100) |> 
  mutate(percentage3_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days = sum(percentage_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days >= 3, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(cohort_percentage3_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days = (percentage3_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days /
                                                                  cohort_n) * 100) |> 
  mutate(percentage5_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days = sum(percentage_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days >= 5, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(cohort_percentage5_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days = (percentage5_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days /
                                                                  cohort_n) * 100) |> 
  mutate(percentage10_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days = sum(percentage_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days >= 10, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(cohort_percentage10_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days = (percentage10_weight_loss_from_baseline_30days /
                                                                  cohort_n) * 100) |> 
  # weight loss 90days
  mutate(weight_change_90days_num = weight_90_days_kg - weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg) |>
  mutate(percentage_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days = ((weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg - weight_90_days_kg) / 
                                                          weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg) * 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(percentage1_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days = sum(percentage_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(cohort_percentage1_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days = (percentage1_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days /
                                                                  cohort_n) * 100) |> 
  mutate(percentage3_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days = sum(percentage_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days >= 3, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(cohort_percentage3_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days = (percentage3_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days /
                                                                  cohort_n) * 100) |> 
  mutate(percentage5_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days = sum(percentage_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days >= 5, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(cohort_percentage5_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days = (percentage5_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days /
                                                                  cohort_n) * 100) |> 
  mutate(percentage10_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days = sum(percentage_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days >= 10, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(cohort_percentage10_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days = (percentage10_weight_loss_from_baseline_90days /
                                                                  cohort_n) * 100) |> 
  
  
    
  
  
  # Myeloma
  rename(true_emd_prior_bsab_type = just_prior_to_bs_ab_initiation_is_there_true_emd_0_none_1_paraskeletal_only_2_true_emd_paraskeletal) |> 
  mutate(true_emd_prior_bsab_type = case_when(
    true_emd_prior_bsab_type == 0                                ~ "None",
    true_emd_prior_bsab_type == 1                                ~ "Paraskeletal only",
    true_emd_prior_bsab_type == 2                                ~ "True EMD (+/-paraskeletal)",
    true_emd_prior_bsab_type == 3                                ~ "True EMD (+/-paraskeletal)",
    TRUE                                                         ~ as.character(true_emd_prior_bsab_type)
  )) %>%
  mutate(true_emd_prior_bsab = case_when(
    true_emd_prior_bsab_type == "True EMD (+/-paraskeletal)"     ~ "Yes",
    true_emd_prior_bsab_type == "Paraskeletal only"              ~ "No",
    true_emd_prior_bsab_type == "None"                           ~ "No"
  )) %>%
  mutate(subtype = case_when(
    oligo_or_non_secretory_at_bs_ab_initiation_0_no_1_yes == "Yes"               ~ "Oligo/non-secretory",
    !is.na(myeloma_involved_heavy_chain_ig_g_ig_a_ig_m_ig_d_ig_e_or_blank) &
      !is.na(myeloma_involved_light_chain_kappa_lambda_biclonal_blank)           ~ "Intact immunoglobulin (Heavy + Light)",
    is.na(myeloma_involved_heavy_chain_ig_g_ig_a_ig_m_ig_d_ig_e_or_blank) &
     !is.na(myeloma_involved_light_chain_kappa_lambda_biclonal_blank)            ~ "Light chain only",
    TRUE           ~ paste(oligo_or_non_secretory_at_bs_ab_initiation_0_no_1_yes,
                           myeloma_involved_light_chain_kappa_lambda_biclonal_blank,
                           myeloma_involved_heavy_chain_ig_g_ig_a_ig_m_ig_d_ig_e_or_blank)
  ), subtype = relevel(as.factor(subtype), ref = "Oligo/non-secretory"
  )) %>%
  mutate(h_o_plasma_cell_leukemia_no_0_yes_1 = case_when(
    h_o_plasma_cell_leukemia_no_0_yes_1 == 2                        ~ "Yes",
    TRUE                                                            ~ h_o_plasma_cell_leukemia_no_0_yes_1
  )) |> 
  # Cytogenetics ----
  mutate(cytogenetics = case_when(
    deletion_17p_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes" |
      t_4_14_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes" |
      t_14_16_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes"                     ~ "High",
    deletion_17p_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "No" &
      t_4_14_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "No" &
      t_14_16_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "No"                      ~ "Standard",
    TRUE                                                             ~ NA_character_
  ), .before = deletion_17p_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes) %>%
  mutate(high_risk_cyto_newdef = case_when(
    deletion_17p_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes"                  ~ "High",
    t_4_14_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes" & 
      gain_amp1q21_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes"                              ~ "High",
    t_14_16_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes" & 
      gain_amp1q21_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes"                              ~ "High",
    t_4_14_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes" & 
      deletion_1p_0_no_1_yes == "Yes"                               ~ "High",
    t_14_16_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes" & 
      deletion_1p_0_no_1_yes == "Yes"                               ~ "High",
    gain_amp1q21_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes" & 
      deletion_1p_0_no_1_yes == "Yes"                               ~ "High",
    is.na(deletion_17p_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes) | 
      is.na(t_4_14_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes) | 
      is.na(t_14_16_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes) | 
      is.na(gain_amp1q21_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes) | 
      is.na(deletion_1p_0_no_1_yes)                                 ~ NA_character_, 
    TRUE                                                            ~ "Standard"
  )) %>%
  mutate(cytogenetics_doublehit = case_when(
    (deletion_17p_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes") +
    (deletion_1p_0_no_1_yes == "Yes") + 
      (gain_amp1q21_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes") +
      (t_4_14_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes") +
      (t_14_16_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes == "Yes") >= 2             ~ "Yes",
    if_any(c(deletion_17p_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes,
             deletion_1p_0_no_1_yes,
             gain_amp1q21_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes,
             t_4_14_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes,
             t_14_16_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes), ~ is.na(.))        ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                            ~ "No"
  ))# |> 
  # select(mrn, cytogenetics_doublehit, deletion_17p_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes, t_4_14_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes,
  #        t_14_16_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes, deletion_1p_0_no_1_yes, gain_amp1q21_prior_to_bs_ab_0_no_1_yes)
```

```{r treatment}
data3 <- data2 %>% 
  mutate(number_of_prior_lines_of_therapy_before_bs_ab_cat = case_when(
    number_of_prior_lines_of_therapy_before_bs_ab <= 4                        ~ "≤ 4",
    number_of_prior_lines_of_therapy_before_bs_ab > 4                         ~ "> 4"
  ), .after = number_of_prior_lines_of_therapy_before_bs_ab) %>%  
  # Refractory status ----
  mutate(across(c("bortezomib_status_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2",
              "carfilzomib_status_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2",
              "lenalidomide_status_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2",
              "pomalidomide_status_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2",
              "daratumumab_or_isatuximab_status_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2"
  ),
  ~ case_when(
    . == 0                                              ~ "Exposed",
    . == 1                                              ~ "Exposed",
    . == 2                                              ~ "Not exposed",
    TRUE                                                ~ NA_character_
  ), .names = "{str_remove(.col, '_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2')}_exposed")) %>%
  mutate(across(c("bortezomib_status_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2",
              "carfilzomib_status_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2",
              "lenalidomide_status_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2",
              "pomalidomide_status_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2",
              "daratumumab_or_isatuximab_status_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2"
  ),
  ~ case_when(
    . == 0                                              ~ "Not refractory",
    . == 1                                              ~ "Refractory",
    . == 2                                              ~ "Not refractory",
    TRUE                                                ~ NA_character_
  ), .names = "{str_remove(.col, '_exposed_0_vs_refractory_1_vs_naive_2')}_refractory")) %>%
  
  mutate(immuno = case_when(
    lenalidomide_status_refractory == "Refractory" |
      pomalidomide_status_refractory == "Refractory"           ~ "Yes",
    lenalidomide_status_refractory != "Refractory" |
      pomalidomide_status_refractory != "Refractory"           ~ "No"
  ), .after = pomalidomide_status_refractory) %>% 
  mutate(proteasome = case_when(
    bortezomib_status_refractory == "Refractory" |
      carfilzomib_status_refractory == "Refractory"            ~ "Yes",
    bortezomib_status_refractory != "Refractory" |
      carfilzomib_status_refractory != "Refractory"            ~ "No"
  ), .after = immuno) %>%
  mutate(dara = case_when(
    daratumumab_or_isatuximab_status_refractory == "Refractory"            ~ "Yes",
    is.na(daratumumab_or_isatuximab_status_refractory)            ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                           ~ "No"
  ), .after = daratumumab_or_isatuximab_status_refractory) %>%
  mutate(doubleref = case_when(
    proteasome == "Yes" &
      immuno == "Yes"                                              ~ "Yes",
    TRUE                                                           ~ "No"
  ), .after = proteasome) %>%
  mutate(tripleexp = case_when(
    (bortezomib_status_exposed == "Exposed" |
      carfilzomib_status_exposed == "Exposed") &
      (lenalidomide_status_exposed == "Exposed" |
      pomalidomide_status_exposed == "Exposed") &
      daratumumab_or_isatuximab_status_exposed == "Exposed"     ~ "Yes",
    TRUE                                                           ~ "No"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(tripleref = case_when(
    proteasome == "Yes" &
      immuno == "Yes" &
      dara == "Yes"                                                ~ "Yes",
    TRUE                                                           ~ "No"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(pentaexp = case_when(
    bortezomib_status_exposed == "Exposed" &
      carfilzomib_status_exposed == "Exposed" &
      lenalidomide_status_exposed == "Exposed" &
      pomalidomide_status_exposed == "Exposed" &
      daratumumab_or_isatuximab_status_exposed == "Exposed"     ~ "Yes",
    TRUE                                                           ~ "No"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(pentaref = case_when(
    bortezomib_status_refractory == "Refractory" & 
      carfilzomib_status_refractory == "Refractory" &
      lenalidomide_status_refractory == "Refractory" & 
      pomalidomide_status_refractory == "Refractory" & 
      dara == "Yes"          ~ "Yes",
    TRUE                                                           ~ "No"
  )) |> 
  mutate(type_of_most_recent_bcma_agent_adc_1_cart_2_bs_ab_3 = case_when(
    type_of_most_recent_bcma_agent_adc_1_cart_2_bs_ab_3 == 1    ~ "ADC",
    type_of_most_recent_bcma_agent_adc_1_cart_2_bs_ab_3 == 2    ~ "CART",
    type_of_most_recent_bcma_agent_adc_1_cart_2_bs_ab_3 == 3    ~ "BsAb"
  )) |> 
  mutate(most_recent_bcma_agent_name = case_when(
    most_recent_bcma_agent_name == "Abecma"                     ~ "Ide-cel",
    most_recent_bcma_agent_name == "Carvykti"                   ~ "Cilta-cel",
    most_recent_bcma_agent_name == "Carvylti"                   ~ "Cilta-cel",
  )) |> 
  mutate(if_prior_cart_which_one_s = case_when(
    if_prior_cart_which_one_s == "Abecma"                       ~ "Ide-cel",
    if_prior_cart_which_one_s == "Abcema"                      ~ "Ide-cel",
    if_prior_cart_which_one_s == "Carvykti"                     ~ "Cilta-cel",
    if_prior_cart_which_one_s == "Carvylti"                     ~ "Cilta-cel",
  )) |> 
  mutate(time_most_recent_bcma_to_initiation_days = 
           interval(
             start = date_of_last_exposure_to_prior_bcma_agent,
             end = date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1)/
           duration(n=1, units = "days"),
         .after = date_of_last_exposure_to_prior_bcma_agent) %>%
  mutate(response_to_most_recent_bmca_agent_cr_1_vgpr_2_pr_3_sd_4_pd_5_ne_6 = case_when(
    response_to_most_recent_bmca_agent_cr_1_vgpr_2_pr_3_sd_4_pd_5_ne_6 == "sCR" ~ "sCR",
    response_to_most_recent_bmca_agent_cr_1_vgpr_2_pr_3_sd_4_pd_5_ne_6 == 1     ~ "CR",
    response_to_most_recent_bmca_agent_cr_1_vgpr_2_pr_3_sd_4_pd_5_ne_6 == 2     ~ "VGPR",
    response_to_most_recent_bmca_agent_cr_1_vgpr_2_pr_3_sd_4_pd_5_ne_6 == 3     ~ "PR",
    response_to_most_recent_bmca_agent_cr_1_vgpr_2_pr_3_sd_4_pd_5_ne_6 == 4     ~ "SD",
    response_to_most_recent_bmca_agent_cr_1_vgpr_2_pr_3_sd_4_pd_5_ne_6 == 5     ~ "PD",
  )) |> 
  mutate(time_last_gprc5d_to_initiation_days = 
           interval(
             start = date_of_last_gprc5d_exposure,
             end = date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1)/
           duration(n=1, units = "days"),
         .after = date_of_last_gprc5d_exposure) %>%
  mutate(days_of_hospital_stay_days = case_when(

  )) |> 
  mutate(days_of_icu_admission = case_when(
    days_of_icu_admission == 0                                      ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE                                                            ~ days_of_icu_admission
  ))
```

```{r baseline}
# Fix the "<" and ">" to take the min or max or each column including numbers next to the signs----
# Also replace "Suboptimal" by NA
vec_col <- c("baseline_ig_g_prior_to_bs_ab_initiation_mg_d_l"
             )
class(data4) <- "data.frame"

for (i in vec_col) {

  if (class(data4[, i]) == "character") {

    data4 <- data4 %>%
      mutate(wo_sign = as.numeric(str_remove(data4[, i], ">|<"))) %>%
      mutate(!!i := case_when(
        str_detect(data4[, i], ">")                 ~ max(wo_sign, na.rm = TRUE),
        str_detect(data4[, i], "<")                 ~ min(wo_sign, na.rm = TRUE),
        TRUE                                         ~ as.numeric(wo_sign)
      )) %>%
      select(-c(wo_sign))
  }
}
```

```{r toxicities}
data5 <- data4 %>% 
# CRS ----
  mutate(crs_any = ifelse(max_crs_grade_0_5 == 0, "No", "Yes"),
       crs_any2 = ifelse(crs_any == "No", 0, 1),
       crs_gradecat2 = case_when(
         max_crs_grade_0_5 == 0                        ~ "No CRS",
         max_crs_grade_0_5 == 1                        ~ "Grade 1",
         max_crs_grade_0_5 >= 2                        ~ "Grade 2+"),
       crs_gradecat2 = factor(crs_gradecat2, levels = c("No CRS", "Grade 1", "Grade 2+")),
       crs_gradecat3 = case_when(
         max_crs_grade_0_5 == 0                        ~ "No CRS",
         max_crs_grade_0_5 %in% c(1:2)                 ~ "Grade 1 or 2",
         max_crs_grade_0_5 >= 3                        ~ "Grade 3+"),
       crs_gradecat3 = factor(crs_gradecat3, levels = c("No CRS", "Grade 1 or 2", "Grade 3+"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(gr3_crs = case_when(
    max_crs_grade_0_5 %in% c(1:2)                      ~ "Grade <3",
    max_crs_grade_0_5 %in% c(3:5)                      ~ "Grade ≥3"
  )) %>%
  mutate(gr2_crs = case_when(
    max_crs_grade_0_5 %in% c(1)                        ~ "Grade <2",
    max_crs_grade_0_5 %in% c(2:5)                      ~ "Grade ≥2"
  )) %>%
  mutate(day_of_onset_crs_relative_to_initiation_days =
           interval(start = date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1, end = date_of_onset_of_crs) /
           duration(n =1, unit = "days")
  ) %>%
  mutate(day_of_max_crs_relative_to_initiation =
           interval(start = date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1, end = date_of_max_crs) /
           duration(n =1, unit = "days")
  ) |> 
  mutate(crs_14d = case_when(
    day_of_onset_crs_relative_to_initiation_days <= 14      ~ "CRS witin 14 days post initiation",
    day_of_onset_crs_relative_to_initiation_days > 14       ~ "No",
    crs_any == "No"                                    ~ "No"
  )) |> 
  mutate(crs_30d = case_when(
    day_of_onset_crs_relative_to_initiation_days <= 30      ~ "CRS witin 30 days post initiation",
    day_of_onset_crs_relative_to_initiation_days > 30       ~ "No",
    crs_any == "No"                                    ~ "No"
  )) |> 
  mutate(max_crs_grade_d14 = case_when(
    crs_14d == "CRS witin 14 days post initiation"     ~ max_crs_grade_0_5
  )) |> 
  mutate(max_crs_grade_d30 = case_when(
    crs_30d == "CRS witin 30 days post initiation"     ~ max_crs_grade_0_5
  )) |> 
  mutate(recurrent_crs_d14 = case_when(
    crs_14d == "CRS witin 14 days post initiation"     ~ recurrent_crs_n_0_y_1
  )) |> 
  mutate(recurrent_crs_d30 = case_when(
    crs_30d == "CRS witin 30 days post initiation"     ~ recurrent_crs_n_0_y_1
  )) |> 
  mutate(time_onset_crs_to_initiation_cat = case_when(
    day_of_onset_crs_relative_to_initiation_days == 1  ~ "1 day",
    day_of_onset_crs_relative_to_initiation_days == 2  ~ "2 day",
    day_of_onset_crs_relative_to_initiation_days > 2   ~ "more than 2 day"
  )) |> 
  # ICANS ----
  mutate(icans_any = ifelse(max_icans_grade == 0, "No", "Yes"),
       icans_any2 = ifelse(icans_any == "No", 0, 1),
       icans_gradecat2 = case_when(
         max_icans_grade == 0                      ~ "No ICANS",
         max_icans_grade == 1                      ~ "Grade 1",
         max_icans_grade >= 2                      ~ "Grade 2+"),
       icans_gradecat2 = factor(icans_gradecat2, levels = c("No ICANS", "Grade 1", "Grade 2+")),
       icans_gradecat3 = case_when(
         max_icans_grade == 0                      ~ "No ICANS",
         max_icans_grade %in% c(1:2)               ~ "Grade 1 or 2",
         max_icans_grade >= 3                      ~ "Grade 3+"),
       icans_gradecat3 = factor(icans_gradecat3, levels = c("No ICANS", "Grade 1 or 2", "Grade 3+")),
       gr3_icans = case_when(
         max_icans_grade %in% c(1:2)               ~ "Grade <3",
         max_icans_grade %in% c(3:5)               ~ "Grade ≥3"
       )) %>%
  mutate(gr2_icans = case_when(
    max_icans_grade %in% c(1)                      ~ "Grade <2",
    max_icans_grade %in% c(2:5)                    ~ "Grade ≥2"
  )) |> 
  mutate(day_of_onset_icans_relative_to_initiation_days =
           interval(start = date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1, end = date_of_onset_of_icans) /
           duration(n =1, unit = "days")
  ) %>%
  mutate(day_of_max_icans_grade_relative_to_initiation =
           interval(start = date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1, end = date_of_max_ican) /

  mutate(icans_14d = case_when(

    day_of_onset_icans_relative_to_initiation_days > 14       ~ "No",

  )) |> 
  mutate(icans_30d = case_when(
    day_of_onset_icans_relative_to_initiation_days <= 30      ~ "ICANS witin 30 days post initiation",
    day_of_onset_icans_relative_to_initiation_days > 30       ~ "No",
    icans_any == "No"                                         ~ "No"
  )) |> 
  mutate(max_icans_grade_d14 = case_when(
    icans_14d == "ICANS witin 14 days post initiation"        ~ max_icans_grade
  )) |> 
  mutate(max_icans_grade_d30 = case_when(
    icans_30d == "ICANS witin 30 days post initiation"        ~ max_icans_grade
  )) |> 
  mutate(time_onset_icans_to_initiation_cat = case_when(
    day_of_onset_icans_relative_to_initiation_days == 1       ~ "1 day",
    day_of_onset_icans_relative_to_initiation_days == 2       ~ "2 day",
    day_of_onset_icans_relative_to_initiation_days > 2        ~ "more than 2 day"
  )) |> 
  mutate(concurent_crs_icans_d14 = case_when(
    crs_14d == "CRS witin 14 days post initiation" &
    icans_14d == "ICANS witin 14 days post initiation"        ~ "Yes",
    !is.na(icans_any) &
      !is.na(crs_any)                                         ~ "No"
  )) |> 
  
  mutate(treatment_delays_during_first_cycle_no_delays_0_infection_1_cytopenias_2_crs_3_icans_4_other_5_explain = str_replace(
    treatment_delays_during_first_cycle_no_delays_0_infection_1_cytopenias_2_crs_3_icans_4_other_5_explain,
    " and ", ", ")) %>%
```

```{r response}
data7 <- data6 %>%   
  mutate(day30_response = case_when(
    (os_event == 1 | pfs_event == 1) &
      pfs_time_from_initiation_months < 1                               ~ "Died or progressed before day 30",
    str_detect(day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "EVAL")        ~ NA_character_,
    day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd == "NE"                    ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "VGPR")        ~ "VGPR",
    str_detect(day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "PR")          ~ "PR",
    # str_detect(day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "UCR")	       ~ "UCR",
    str_detect(day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "CR")          ~ "sCR or CR",
    str_detect(day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "MR") |
      str_detect(day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "SD")        ~ "SD",
    str_detect(day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "PD")          ~ "PD",
    is.na(day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd)                     ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                                ~ day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd
  ), .after = day_30_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd) %>%
  mutate(day30_response_v2 = case_when(
    str_detect(day30_response, "Died")                               ~ "PD",
    is.na(day30_response)                                            ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                             ~ day30_response
  ), .after = day30_response) %>%
  mutate(ORR_30days = case_when(
    str_detect(day30_response_v2, "CR|PR")                           ~ "PR or better",
    is.na(day30_response_v2)                                         ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                             ~ "< PR"
  ), .after = day30_response_v2) %>%
  mutate(CRorbetter_30days = case_when(
    str_detect(day30_response_v2, "CR")	                             ~ "sCR or CR",
    is.na(day30_response_v2)                                         ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                             ~ "< CR"
  ), .after = ORR_30days) %>%
  mutate(VGPRorbetter_30days = case_when(
    CRorbetter_30days == "sCR or CR"                        	       ~ "VGPR or better",
    day30_response_v2 == "VGPR"                        	             ~ "VGPR or better",
    is.na(day30_response_v2)                                         ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                             ~ "< VGPR"
  ), .after = CRorbetter_30days) %>%
  # Day 90 response ----
  mutate(mon3_response = case_when(
    day30_response_v2 == "PD"                                         ~ "PD", #if was PD, is always PD
    (os_event == 1 | pfs_event == 1) &
      pfs_time_from_initiation_months < 3                             ~ "Died or progressed before 3 months",
    str_detect(day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "EVAL")      ~ NA_character_,
    day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd == "NE"                  ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "VGPR")      ~ "VGPR",
    str_detect(day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "VPGR")      ~ "VGPR",
    str_detect(day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "PR")        ~ "PR",
    str_detect(day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "CR")	      ~ "sCR or CR",
    str_detect(day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "MR") |
      str_detect(day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "SD")      ~ "SD",
    str_detect(day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd, "PD")        ~ "PD",
    is.na(day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd)                   ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE           ~ day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd
  ), .after = day_90_response_s_cr_cr_vgpr_pr_mr_sd_pd) %>%
  mutate(mon3_response_v2 = case_when(

  mutate_at(c("best_response_to_treatment_number_1_after_post_bi_te_progression",
              "best_response_to_treatment_number_2_after_post_bi_te_progression"), ~ case_when(
    . == "NE"                  ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(., "VGPR")      ~ "VGPR",
    str_detect(., "PR")        ~ "PR",
    str_detect(., "CR")	      ~ "sCR or CR",
    str_detect(., "MR") |
      str_detect(., "SD")      ~ "SD",
    str_detect(., "PD")        ~ "PD",
    is.na(.)                   ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE           ~ .
  ))
```

```{r infection}
data8 <- data7 |> 
  # Add data we requested to fill the blank on 4 patients
  # select(mrn, patient_identifier, date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1, pathogen, number_of_infections, infection_n_0_y_1,
  #        starts_with("infection_type_"), starts_with("date_of_infection_"), starts_with("infection_severity_")) |>
  mutate(date_of_infection_1 = case_when(
    infection_n_0_y_1 == "Yes" &
      is.na(date_of_infection_1) &
      infection_type_1 == "Bacterial"                   ~ as.Date("2023-3-15"),
    infection_n_0_y_1 == "Yes" &
      is.na(date_of_infection_1) &
      infection_type_1 == "Fungal"                      ~ as.Date("2023-7-15"),
    infection_n_0_y_1 == "Yes" &
      is.na(date_of_infection_1) &
      infection_type_1 == "Viral"                       ~ as.Date("2026-2-12"),
    TRUE                                                ~ date_of_infection_1
  )) |> 
  mutate(infection_severity_1 = case_when(
    !is.na(infection_severity_1)                        ~ infection_severity_1,
    infection_n_0_y_1 == "Yes" &
      is.na(date_of_infection_1)                        ~ "No"
  )) |> 
  mutate(infection_type_1 = case_when(
    !is.na(infection_type_1)                            ~ infection_type_1,
    infection_n_0_y_1 == "Yes" &
      is.na(date_of_infection_1)                        ~ "Viral"
  )) |> 
  mutate(date_of_infection_1 = case_when(
    !is.na(date_of_infection_1)                         ~ date_of_infection_1,
    infection_n_0_y_1 == "Yes" &
      is.na(date_of_infection_1)                        ~ as.Date("2023-7-15")
  ))

bsab_inf <-
  data8 |> 
  select(mrn, patient_identifier, date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1, pathogen, number_of_infections, infection_n_0_y_1,
         starts_with("infection_type_"), starts_with("date_of_infection_"), starts_with("infection_severity_")) |> 
  # Fix unknown pathogen before pivot
  mutate(pathogen = str_replace(pathogen, "^,", "empty,")) |> 
  mutate(pathogen = str_replace(pathogen, ",$", ", empty")) |> 
  mutate(pathogen = str_replace_na(pathogen, "empty")) |> 
  mutate(pathogen_count = sapply(strsplit(pathogen, ","), length), .after = pathogen) %>% 
  # Separate pathogen to have same format as infection severity, dates etc
  separate_wider_delim(cols = pathogen, delim = ", ",
                       names = c(paste("pathogen", 1:max(.$pathogen_count), sep = "_")), 
                       too_few = "align_start", too_many = "merge", 
                       cols_remove = TRUE) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(mrn, patient_identifier, date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1, number_of_infections, infection_n_0_y_1), 
               names_pattern = "(date_of_infection|infection_type|infection_severity|pathogen)(_1|_2|_3|_4).*",
               names_to = c(".value", "sequence"), 
               values_drop_na = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(infection_n_0_y_1 = case_when(
    infection_n_0_y_1 == 2                              ~ "Yes",
    TRUE                                                ~ infection_n_0_y_1
  )) |> 
  # Fix - Remove data for a patient "The positive VRE surveillance screen consistent with colonization only"
  mutate(across(c("infection_type", 
                  "infection_severity"), 
                ~ case_when(
    infection_n_0_y_1 == "No" &
      number_of_infections > 0                          ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                ~ as.character(.)
  ))) |> 
  mutate(date_of_infection = case_when(
    infection_n_0_y_1 == "No" &
      number_of_infections > 0                          ~ NA_Date_,
    TRUE                                                ~ date_of_infection
  )) |> 
  mutate(pathogen = case_when(
    infection_n_0_y_1 == "No" &
      number_of_infections > 0                          ~ "empty",
    TRUE                                                ~ pathogen
  )) |> 
  # Moderate infection is not severe
  mutate(infection_severity = case_when(
    infection_severity == "Moderate"                    ~ "No",
    TRUE                                                ~ infection_severity
  )) |> 
  # 4 patients (5 dates) are identical as date of bsab - exclude
  mutate(infection_severity = case_when(
    date_of_infection == date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1       ~ "REMOVE",
    TRUE                                                ~ infection_severity
  )) |> 
  # Filter them out but keep the one in first position to be changed to No
  filter(infection_n_0_y_1 == "No" |
           infection_severity != "REMOVE" |
           is.na(infection_severity) |
           (infection_severity == "REMOVE" & sequence == "_1")) |> 
  mutate(date_of_infection = case_when(
    infection_severity == "REMOVE"                      ~ NA_Date_,
    TRUE                                                ~ date_of_infection
  )) |> 
  mutate(pathogen = case_when(
    infection_severity == "REMOVE"                      ~ "empty",
    TRUE                                                ~ pathogen
  )) |> 
  mutate(infection_n_0_y_1 = case_when(
    infection_severity == "REMOVE"                      ~ "No",
    TRUE                                                ~ infection_n_0_y_1
  )) |> 
  mutate(across(c("infection_type", 
                  "infection_severity"), 
                ~ case_when(
    infection_severity == "REMOVE"                      ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                ~ as.character(.)
  ))) |> 
  # Recode number of infection
  group_by(mrn, patient_identifier) |> 
  mutate(number_of_infections = n()) |> 
  mutate(sequence = row_number()) |> 
  mutate(has_second_infection = case_when(
    sequence == 2             ~ "Yes"
  )) |> 
  fill(has_second_infection, .direction = "updown") |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(is.na(has_second_infection) |
           has_second_infection == "Yes" & infection_n_0_y_1 == "Yes") |> 
  mutate(number_of_infections = case_when(
    infection_n_0_y_1 == "No"                           ~ 0,
    TRUE                                                ~ number_of_infections
  )) |> 
  select(-has_second_infection) |> 
  # calculate time for each infection
  mutate(time_from_bsab_therapy_to_infection_days = 
           interval(
             start = date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1, 
             end = date_of_infection) /
           duration(n=1, units = "days")) |> 
  arrange(mrn, time_from_bsab_therapy_to_infection_days) |> 
  mutate(time_from_bsab_therapy_to_infection_months = 
           interval(
             start = date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1, 
             end = date_of_infection) /
           duration(n=1, units = "months")) |> 
  arrange(mrn, time_from_bsab_therapy_to_infection_days) |> 
  # Remove placeholder in pathogen
  mutate(pathogen = na_if(pathogen, "empty")) |> 
  rename(any_infection = infection_n_0_y_1) |> 
  mutate(any_sevinfection = case_when(
    infection_severity == "Yes"                       ~ "Yes"
  )) |> 
  group_by(mrn, patient_identifier) |> 
  fill(any_sevinfection, .direction = "updown") |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(any_sevinfection = case_when(
    any_sevinfection == "Yes"                         ~ "Yes",
    any_infection == "Yes" &
      is.na(infection_severity)                       ~ "Unknown"
  )) |> 
  group_by(mrn, patient_identifier) |> 
  fill(any_sevinfection, .direction = "updown") |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(any_sevinfection = case_when(
    any_sevinfection == "Yes"                         ~ "Yes",
    any_sevinfection == "Unknown"                     ~ NA_character_,
    infection_severity == "No"                        ~ "No"
  )) |> 
  group_by(mrn, patient_identifier) |> 
  fill(any_sevinfection, .direction = "updown") |> 
  ungroup()

bsab_inf_wide <-
  bsab_inf |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(mrn, patient_identifier, date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1,
                          number_of_infections, any_infection, any_sevinfection), 
              names_from = c(sequence),
              values_from = c(pathogen, infection_type, date_of_infection, infection_severity, 
                          time_from_bsab_therapy_to_infection_days,
                          time_from_bsab_therapy_to_infection_months),
              names_vary = "slowest",
              names_glue = "{.value}_{sequence}"
              ) |> 
  select(-date_of_bs_ab_step_up_d1)

bsab_data <- data8 |> 
  # Remove varaibles that I have re-done
  select(-c(pathogen, number_of_infections, infection_n_0_y_1,
         starts_with("infection_type_"), starts_with("date_of_infection_"), 
         starts_with("infection_severity_"))) |> 
  left_join(bsab_inf_wide, by = c("mrn", "patient_identifier")) #|>
```

# Tables
## Table Demographic
```{r Table 1}
bsab_data %>% 
  select(age_at_bs_ab_initiation, age_cat, age_3cat,
         # male_sex, 
         sex_0_male_1_female,
         race,
         ethnicity,
         raceeth,
         weight_cat,
         weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg,
         prophylactic_tocilizumab_n_0_y_1
         ) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = prophylactic_tocilizumab_n_0_y_1,
              type = list(c(age_at_bs_ab_initiation, weight_at_initiation_of_bs_ab_kg) ~ "continuous2",
                          c(all_dichotomous()#, -male_sex
                            ) ~ "categorical"),
              statistic = list(c(all_continuous2()) ~ c(
                "{mean} ({sd})",
                "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                "{min}, {max}")), 
              digits = all_continuous() ~ 1
  ) %>% 
  bold_labels() %>% add_stat_label() %>% 
  add_p() %>% bold_p(t = 0.05) %>% add_overall() %>% 
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "Prophylactic Tocilizumab") %>% 
  remove_footnote_header(columns = everything()) %>% as_gt()
```

# Survival

## OS
Median OS in months
```{r}
survfit(Surv(time = bsab_data$os_time_from_initiation_months,
                   event = bsab_data$os_event) ~ 1,
              data = bsab_data) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = 0.5,
    label_header = "**Median survival (95% CI)**"
  ) %>% add_nevent() %>% add_n()
survfit(Surv(time = bsab_data$os_time_from_initiation_months,
                   event = bsab_data$os_event) ~ prophylactic_tocilizumab_n_0_y_1,
              data = bsab_data) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = 0.5,
    label_header = "**Median survival (95% CI)**"
  ) %>% add_nevent() %>% add_n()

list(
  survfit(Surv(time = bsab_data$os_time_from_initiation_months,
               event = bsab_data$os_event) ~ 1,
          data = bsab_data),
  survfit(Surv(time = bsab_data$os_time_from_initiation_months,
               event = bsab_data$os_event) ~ prophylactic_tocilizumab_n_0_y_1,
          data = bsab_data)
) %>%
  tbl_survfit(times = c(6, 12),
              label_header = "**OS Rate at {time} Months**")
```

```{r KM OS, fig.height=6}
ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(os_time_from_initiation_months, os_event) ~ prophylactic_tocilizumab_n_0_y_1,
                   data=bsab_data),
           font.main = c(20, "bold", "black"),
           font.x = c(12, "plain", "black"),
           font.y = c(12, "plain", "black"),
           font.legend = c(10, "plain", "black"),
           font.tickslab = c(10, "plain", "black"),
           size = 1.5,

           xlab = "Time (months)",
           ylab = "OS (probability)",
           legend = "top", legend.title = "", 
           # legend.labs = c("", ""),
           pval = TRUE, pval.size = 4, 
           conf.int = FALSE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           risk.table.fontsize = 4,
           tables.y.text = FALSE,
           tables.theme = theme_classic()+
             theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
                   # plot.title = element_text(size = 10),  # Table title ("Number at risk")
                   axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),                # Time ticks (x-axis)
                   axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12)                # X-axis label ("Time")
             ),
           # Censor
           censor = TRUE
) %++% guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
```

# NRM
NRM is defined as death unrelated to Multiple Myeloma; therefore, any death occurring after disease progression (PD) is classified as non-NRM.
```{r, fig.height=6}
nrm_curves <- bsab_data %>% 
  mutate(nrm_response = case_when(
    os_event == 0                        ~ 0,
    
    os_event == 1 &
      str_detect(cause_of_death_pd_1_infection_while_of_bs_ab_2_crs_3_icans_4_other_5_explain, "1|PD|mm")
                                         ~ 0,# 0
    os_event == 1 &
      !is.na(date_of_pd)                 ~ 0,# 0
    
    
    os_event == 1                        ~ 1
  )) #%>% 
  # select(patient_identifier, os_event, os_time_from_initiation_months, nrm_response,
  #        date_of_last_contact, date_of_pd, cause_of_death_pd_1_infection_while_of_bs_ab_2_crs_3_icans_4_other_5_explain)

ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(os_time_from_initiation_months, nrm_response) ~ prophylactic_tocilizumab_n_0_y_1,
                   data=nrm_curves),
           fun = "event",
           font.main = c(20, "bold", "black"),
           font.x = c(12, "plain", "black"),
           font.y = c(12, "plain", "black"),
           font.legend = c(10, "plain", "black"),
           font.tickslab = c(10, "plain", "black"),
           size = 1.5,
           surv.median.line = "hv",

           xlab = "Time (months)",
           ylab = "Cumulative Incidence of NRM",
           legend = "top", legend.title = "",
           # legend.labs = c("", "", ""),
           pval = TRUE, pval.size = 4,
           conf.int = FALSE,
           risk.table = TRUE,
           risk.table.fontsize = 3,
           tables.y.text = FALSE,
           tables.theme = theme_classic()+
             theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
                   # plot.title = element_text(size = 10),  # Table title ("Number at risk")
                   axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),                # Time ticks (x-axis)
                   axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12)                # X-axis label ("Time")
             ),
           # Censor
           censor = TRUE
) %++% guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
```
